name: Early-Stage Startup
description: Pre-seed to Series A. 1-50 employees. Finding product-market fit.
org_structure: Flat or no formal org chart. Founders + early employees do everything. Roles blur.
decision_making: Founder-led. Fast. Informal. Board has 1-3 seats (founders + VC).
hiring: First 10 hires set culture. Generalists > specialists. Equity-heavy comp. No HR department — founder handles.
process_maturity: Minimal process. Speed over rigor. Docs are sparse.
compensation: Below market salary + significant equity. 4-year vest, 1-year cliff. 409A valuations.
